# Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**1. Sticky week-timeline sidebar (left rail, full height)**
- **Layout:** ~90px wide rail; Mon–Sun as circular nodes connected by a dotted vertical line; "today" node filled coral, others outlined. Nodes anchor-scroll to page sections.
- **Visual:** Deep forest green (#1E3A2F) rail, cream nodes, coral (#FF6F5E) active state. Collapses to a horizontal strip on mobile.
- **Copy:** Tiny rotated label "YOUR WEEK" at top.

**2. Hero (right of sidebar)**
- **Layout:** Two-column — headline left, app screenshot right showing a team's Monday board.
- **Visual:** Display serif headline in forest green on cream; hand-drawn coral arrow curving from headline to screenshot, annotated in casual script: *"your team's week, live."*
- **Copy:** Keep the breathless run-on style: "Gather your small team around one shared plan for the week that updates as work happens, carries unfinished threads forward automatically, and ends the Monday meeting where everyone pretends to know what everyone else is doing."

**3. Feature rows (×3)**
- **Layout:** Alternating image/text rows.
- **Visual:** Cream background; forest green body sans; small coral hand-drawn underlines and margin notes ("no status pings!") on each product shot.
- **Copy:** Weekly canvas, async daily check-ins, Friday wrap-up. Benefit-led headings, one-line support each.

**4. Pull quote**
- **Layout:** Full-width band, inverted forest green background.
- **Visual:** Monospace type, coral quotation marks, small avatar + name/team.
- **Copy:** "We cancelled our Monday sync in week two. Nobody has missed it." — eng lead, 7-person team.

**5. "How a week flows" strip**
- **Layout:** Horizontal Mon→Fri mini-timeline echoing the sidebar motif.
- **Visual:** Dotted connectors, coral day markers, micro-screenshots per day.

**6. CTA + footer**
- **Layout:** Centered.
- **Visual:** Coral "Start your first week free" button on cream; forest green footer.
- **Copy:** One reassurance line: "Five minutes on Monday. Calm all week."

# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**What changed:** The page now *is* a week — each section maps to a day, so the sidebar becomes structural navigation, not decoration. The redundant "week flows" strip is cut. Headline payoff fixed to end warm and concrete, like the original's "forgets the milk." Proof band and objection-handling added.

**1. Sidebar — the week as navigation**
- Mon–Sun nodes on a dotted spine, with live dates; "today" ringed in coral. Sections carry day labels, so clicking "Wed" jumps to feature two. Forest green (#1E3A2F) rail, cream nodes; collapses to a horizontal strip on mobile.

**2. Monday — Hero**
- Two-column: headline left, screenshot of a live team week-board right. Display serif (Fraunces) in forest on cream. Coral hand-drawn arrow curves to the screenshot, annotated in script: *"your week, live."*
- **Headline:** "Bring every person on your team around one living plan for the week that updates the moment work moves, carries unfinished threads forward on its own, and quietly takes the guesswork out of Monday morning so nobody ever starts the week guessing."
- **Proof band** beneath: "Trusted by 1,200+ teams of 2–20," tiny muted logo row.

**3. Tuesday–Thursday — feature rows (×3)**
- Alternating rows on cream/sand (#F3EBDD). Screenshots carry the same script-annotation voice — coral margin notes like *"no status pings"* — making the hero arrow a system, not a one-off.
- Benefit-led headings: "See the whole week at a glance" / "Check in without a meeting" / "Friday's wrap-up, written for you." One supporting line each.

**4. Friday — pull quote**
- Inverted forest band. IBM Plex Mono, oversized coral quotation marks, avatar + role.
- **Copy:** "We cancelled our Monday sync in week two. Nobody has missed it." — eng lead, 7-person team.

**5. Weekend — CTA + footer**
- Centered coral button: "Start your first week free." Objection line: "Free up to 5 people · no credit card." Reassurance: "Five minutes Monday. Calm all week."
- Forest footer, minimal links.
